SP_MII_MolGen_GenomicStudyAnalysis_MethodType

Parameter method-type:token

Finds analyses by the sequencing or genotyping method applied (for example targeted panel, whole exome, whole genome). The method sits in the genomic-study-analysis-method-type extension, which no base Procedure search parameter reaches.
